diff --git a/inkwell/text.py b/inkwell/text.py
index fa7ba01..12199b6 100644
--- a/inkwell/text.py
+++ b/inkwell/text.py
@@ -1,8 +1,12 @@
 import re
+import unicodedata
 
 
 def slugify(title):
     """Turn a post title into a URL slug: 'Hello, World!' -> 'hello-world'."""
+    # Normalize to decompose characters (e.g., 'í' -> 'i' + accent mark)
+    title = unicodedata.normalize('NFKD', title).encode('ascii', 'ignore').decode('ascii')
+    # Now apply the regex
     slug = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", title.lower())
     return slug.strip("-")
 
diff --git a/tests/test_text.py b/tests/test_text.py
index 37b7ae7..677deab 100644
--- a/tests/test_text.py
+++ b/tests/test_text.py
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 import unittest

+from inkwell.text import excerpt, reading_time, slugify
 
 
 class TextTests(unittest.TestCase):
@@ -10,6 +10,21 @@ class TextTests(unittest.TestCase):
     def test_excerpt_cuts_at_a_word(self):
         self.assertEqual(excerpt("one two three", limit=8), "one two…")
 
+    def test_slugify_basic(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
+
+    def test_slugify_with_punctuation(self):
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Title with! many? symbols."), "title-with-many-symbols")
+
+    def test_slugify_from_post_hello(self):
+        # Based on posts/2026-10-01-hello.md title: "Hello, World!"
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello, World!"), "hello-world")
+
+    def test_slugify_from_post_dia_de_los_muertos(self):
+        # Based on posts/2026-10-20-dia-de-los-muertos.md title: "Día de los Muertos"
+        # The current implementation will treat 'í' as a non-alphanumeric character.
+        self.assertEqual(slugify("Día de los Muertos"), "dia-de-los-muertos")
+
 
 if __name__ == "__main__":
-    unittest.main()
+    unittest.main()
